mentions.name: Handpicked: Movies by People
mentions.description: A movie discovery app built as a deck of about 700 cards, where each card carries a one-line note from people on why a given movie is worth watching. Browsing the deck makes it easy to flip through and find something to watch.
mentions.problem: The builders struggled to find what to watch at night: existing recommendation systems didn't work for them, and following human curators means dealing with each curator's preferences and having to follow many of them.
mentions.source_excerpt: We built this small app where people just enter one-line text on why you should watch that movie. Since it's only a deck of cards of movies, it's really easy to go through them and find what you like. About 700 cards at the moment.
